evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure readings are unavailable throughout the run.
Growth readings are stable: T 749.8 °C versus 750 °C setpoint, heater power 43.6%, Ar 99.4 versus 100 sccm, and exhaust O2 5.1 ppm; these do not establish tube pressure.
Growth requires control thermocouple, tube pressure gauge, and exhaust O2 sensor; the required pressure measurement is unavailable.
